properties.avoid_when: A control that needs reactive local state — that is the Alpine case.
properties.instruction: Wire the interaction with pattern `widget.data-delegated-behaviour`: a `data-*` attribute plus one `document`-level listener in `app.js`, re-run on `htmx:after:swap`. Do not add a new Alpine component.
properties.name: data-* delegated behaviour
properties.when_to_use: A small interaction that must survive htmx swaps (autogrow, char count, dialog open/close, property row add/remove, confirm gate).

properties.avoid_when: Single-row actions — use edit.row-menu or edit.row-action.
contract_other: one <form> per dialog, submits CSV ids
properties.instruction: Implement bulk selection with an Alpine `sel` array on the page root; row checkboxes carry no `name`; each dialog owns its own `<form>` and submits the selection as one CSV `ids` to the bulk endpoint.
properties.name: Bulk selection
properties.when_to_use: Multi-row selection with a bulk action bar and per-action dialogs.

properties.avoid_when: Page-local search — that belongs in the page header.
properties.instruction: Use `ui.CommandPalette` for pattern `widget.command-palette`; rows htmx-navigate and must uncheck `#spotlight-toggle`.
properties.name: Command palette

properties.avoid_when: A plain menu of links — use a CSS ui.Dropdown instead.
contract_other: closed state rendered server-side style=display:none (not redundant with x-show/x-cloak)
properties.instruction: Build the listbox with pattern `widget.visibility-listbox`: Alpine x-data/x-show/x-cloak on a stable-id element, and render the closed state server-side as style="display:none" so htmx restore cannot drop it.
properties.name: Visibility listbox
properties.when_to_use: A closed/open listbox rendered with Alpine reactive state (agent visibility picker).

properties.avoid_when: Long, actionable, provider-style messages that need reading room — those use the memory-alert modal.
contract_other: inline responses use the memory-toast HX-Trigger with {kind, message}
properties.instruction: Report the result with pattern `feedback.toast`: render `flashToasts(flashMsg, flashErr)` for PRG flows, emit the `memory-toast` `HX-Trigger` for inline responses, or call `MemoryApp.toast(kind, message)` from client JS. Severity is load-bearing — pass `error` for failures.
properties.name: Toast feedback
properties.recipe:
@flashToasts(flashMsg, flashErr) // error-then-success pair; both skipped when unset

window.MemoryApp.toast("error", "Save failed: " + err.message); // persists until closed
properties.when_to_use: An action (mutation, inline save, async job) should report success or failure without navigating.

properties.avoid_when: Multi-field edits — link to the detail page.
contract_aria: control has aria-label naming the target
contract_other: server responds through the PRG/flash contract
non-boolean inline actions: ui.Button of ui.ButtonTypeSubmit in a one-field form
properties.instruction: Add an in-row action using pattern `edit.row-action`: a small `<form method="post" action="/…/toggle">` wrapping the control; a toggle submits itself via `onchange="this.form.submit()"`. Feedback via PRG.
properties.name: In-row state mutation
properties.recipe:
<form method="post" action={ templ.URL("/schedules/" + a.ID + "/toggle") }>
  @form.ToggleInput(form.ToggleInputProps{
    Name: "enabled", Checked: a.Enabled, Class: "toggle toggle-sm",
    Attrs: templ.Attributes{"aria-label": "Toggle " + a.Name, "onchange": "this.form.submit()"},
  })
</form>
properties.when_to_use: One boolean/state control lives in a list row and should apply immediately (enable/disable a schedule, Run now).

properties.avoid_when: A single primary action — render a button.
contract_other: positioning via PopoverContent.Placement, never inline styles
purely CSS menus with no JS state use ui.Dropdown instead
properties.instruction: Add a row action menu using pattern `edit.row-menu`: `ui.Popover` with `PopoverTrigger` + `PopoverContent(Placement: PopoverBottomEnd)`, `role="menuitemradio"`/`aria-checked` for selectable entries, and `ui.PopoverScript()` once on the page.
properties.name: Row action menu
properties.when_to_use: A row/entity has several secondary actions.

contract_other: destructive control is omitted by role, not disabled
properties.instruction: Guard the delete with pattern `edit.confirm`: a `ui.ConfirmDialog`, opened by `MemoryApp.openDeleteConfirm(id, name)`, posting to the delete route. For an inline form that needs a confirm gate before submit, add `data-requires-confirm`.
properties.name: Destructive confirmation

properties.avoid_when: Long forms (they belong on a page) or nested dialogs.
contract_other: dialog id stable and passed literally to MemoryApp.openDialog
MemoryApp.openAgentForm for the domain case; MemoryApp.openDialog generic; window.openDialogByID for per-row dialogs
properties.instruction: Add a create/edit dialog for `<entity>` using pattern `edit.modal`: `ui.Dialog` with a stable id, opened by `MemoryApp.openDialog(id)` from a `data-action` button; use `components.DialogAutoOpen()` when the dialog must re-open after an htmx swap.
properties.name: Create/edit dialog
properties.when_to_use: A short create/edit that should preserve page context (agent create).

properties.avoid_when: A single independent field — that is edit.inline-htmx or edit.inline-autosave.
contract_other: field ids prefixed with the form (edit-sched-…)
errors ride ?err= via redirectWithError → flashError → flashToasts
properties.instruction: Add an edit form for `<entity>` using pattern `edit.form-save`: `ui.Section` → `<form method="post" action="/…">` with `form.FormControl` fields, a `components.SaveChangesButton` in `form.FormActions`, POST → PRG `?updated=1` → `flashToasts`.
properties.name: Full-page form + Save (PRG)
properties.when_to_use: A multi-field creator/editor whose fields are coupled, or any action unsafe to auto-save.

contract_other: field id == name == endpoint last segment
wrap with L3 settingsField for label/hint/tooltip
properties.instruction: Add inline save to this field using pattern `edit.inline-htmx`: `hx-post` to the field endpoint, `hx-trigger="change delay:400ms"` (text) or `change` (select/toggle), `hx-include="this"`, `hx-swap="none"`. The handler upserts and returns a toast; no navigation.
properties.name: Field-level inline save
properties.recipe:
<input id="project-name" name="name" type="text" value={ p.Name } class="input w-full"
       hx-post="/settings/project/name" hx-trigger="change delay:400ms"
       hx-include="this" hx-swap="none"/>
properties.when_to_use: A single field has its own endpoint and should persist on change while the user stays on the page — project settings name/info/budget, per-model price overrides.

properties.avoid_when: Destructive/irreversible actions, or fields that must commit atomically as a group — those use edit.form-save.
contract_other: text inputs debounce 700ms (SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS); selects/pickers save on change
failed save keeps edited values and offers retry
status node reflects saving/saved/error, not a toast
delegated init on load and htmx:after:swap
properties.instruction: Make this settings form auto-save using pattern `edit.inline-autosave`: add `data-agent-autosave` to the `<form>` plus a `data-autosave-url` POST target (JS falls back to `action`), a `data-autosave-status` node (icon + `data-autosave-status-label` + retry), keep each field `name=`. No `hx-*` wiring — the JS owns the request.
properties.name: Form-level auto-save
properties.recipe: All changes saved
properties.when_to_use: A settings form of many independent, low-risk fields where the user expects changes to stick without a Save (agent General subpage).

properties.avoid_when: Ad-hoc <dl> grids — the label style has one definition.
contract_other: empty value falls back to EmptyDash unless NoEmptyDash
spacing owned centrally, never in the component
properties.instruction: Render the facts with pattern `layout.card-grid`: `components.MetaGrid` + one `components.MetaRow` per field; use `MetaRowCustom` for status copy and `components.EmptyDash` for absent values.
properties.name: Cards & meta
properties.when_to_use: Surfacing summary facts or definition-list metadata.

properties.avoid_when: Fewer than ~3 sections — tabs inside one page are lighter.
contract_other: one RailItem per section; active matches Key
RailItem.Custom carries irregular entries (nested group, trailing badge)
role-gated entries are omitted, not disabled
properties.instruction: Add a `<Name>` section to Settings using pattern `layout.settings-rail`: append a `RailItem` to `settingsSubNav` and render the page as `layout.Rail(settingsSubNav(active, providersMissing), nil) { … }`.
properties.name: Settings area
properties.when_to_use: Many sibling configuration sections that each deserve a URL and a shared vertical rail (General / Assistant / Members / Overrides / Providers).

properties.avoid_when: Never hand-roll a header — detailHeader is the convention.
contract_aria: aria-current=page on the active sub-nav item
properties.exception_reason: objectDetailHeader (objects.templ:874) hand-rolls a type chip before the h1 because detailHeader's Leading slot renders above the breadcrumbs. Documented exception — prefer extending detailHeader opts.
properties.instruction: Add a `<Entity>` detail page using pattern `layout.detail`: `layout.Container(LG)` → `detailHeader(crumbs, kicker, title, subtitle)` → stacked `ui.Section`/`components.PanelCard` sections; if it has sub-sections, add a `layout.Rail` with `components.SettingsRail` + `SubNavItem`.
properties.name: Detail page
properties.when_to_use: One entity with a header, optional sub-navigation rail, and stacked sections.

properties.avoid_when: The collection is short and read-only — use layout.card-grid inside an existing page instead of a dedicated route.
contract_other: desktop rows: components.TableCard (go-daisy table.*); mobile rows: components.ListRow; both wrap PageCard
properties.instruction: Add a `<Entity>` list page using pattern `layout.list`: `layout.Container(LG)` → `pageHeader` (with a primary action) → a desktop `components.TableCard` table and a mobile list, with an empty state and `pageError` on load failure. Follow `AgentsPage`.
properties.name: List page
properties.when_to_use: A collection needs filters, sorting, an empty state and per-row actions.
